request.spec:
The sheet has grace days (settings, a whole number, blank means off, not dated; SETTING_CHANGED
key=grace-days value=<days>). When the sheet's today is changed, every open period whose to-date
plus the grace days is before the new today is closed, in order of their to-dates, exactly as a
close by hand would, each writing PERIOD_CLOSED with auto=yes at its end; these lines come after
the new today is set and before the rollup lines of the today change.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
The sheet has grace days (settings, a whole number, blank means off, not dated; SETTING_CHANGED
key=grace-days value=<days>). When the sheet's today is changed, every open period whose to-date
plus the grace days is before the new today is closed, in order of their to-dates, exactly as a
close by hand would, each writing PERIOD_CLOSED with auto=yes at its end; these lines come after
the new today is set and before the rollup lines of the today change.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
Grace days now work: when the sheet's today is changed, every open period whose to-date plus the grace days is before the new today gets closed. `bin/e2e` builds the app and runs the spec, and all 4 tests pass.

**What changed**
- **Stored data:** a new migration `V38__grace_days.sql` adds a nullable `sheet.grace_days` column. Null means off, and the value is not dated.
- **Setting:** the settings save accepts a whole number of days, 0 or more, or blank for off; anything else is refused. Every save of the field writes `SETTING_CHANGED … key=grace-days value=<days>` (blank when off).
- **Today change:** a new `AutoClosePeriods` step in `today.PUT.yml` runs after the new today is saved and before the rollup step. It closes the matching periods in order of their to-dates, and each one writes `PERIOD_CLOSED … period=<name> total=<total> auto=yes`.
- **Same calculation as closing by hand:** I moved the due-total code out of `ClosePeriod` into a shared `PeriodCloser`. The manual close and the automatic one both use it, so their totals are always the same. The manual close's audit line is unchanged.
- **Front end:** the settings form has a new `setting-grace-days` field and shows the current value in `setting-grace-days-current`.

**One choice for you:** the automatic close ignores the permission matrix. Periods close whatever role the person changing today has, because I treated it as a sheet rule rather than an action by that person. "Exactly as a close by hand would" could also mean skipping periods that person isn't allowed to close. The tests don't check either case, and adding that check would be a small change if you want it.
